title: MissionForge individual awards
description: Individual recognition at debrief (design section 11.5). Positive only: no shaming and no last place.

$schema.description: Optional relative path to the JSON Schema of this file, for editor support. Loaders ignore it.

design_notes.description: Designer-facing notes about ambiguities or decisions. Never shown to players and never localised.

rules.description: Rules that apply to the whole award ceremony.

min_awards_per_player.description: Lowest number of awards every player receives at debrief.

positive_only.description: True if no award may shame a player or mark a last place.

rules.description: Tag of the numbers in rules.

id.description: Unique award ID, for example budget_hawk.

name_key.description: String key of the award name.

description_key.description: String key of the parenthetical after the name in the design. Omit when the design gives none.

selection.description: highest = the player with the highest value of metric wins; condition = every player for whom the boolean metric holds may win.

metric.description: Per-player metric the award is judged on, snake_case. Each metric used in data must be implemented by Core.

role.description: Role the award is limited to (Budget Hawk: PM).

minigames.description: Minigames whose result the metric reads.

design_notes.description: Designer-facing notes about ambiguities or decisions. Never shown to players and never localised.
